attempts.surface: Expert manager UI, unified conversation and Trace; read-only source/install filesystem comparison

actual_preconditions.fixture: round-agent-bundled-call-20261006 imported round-owned package with metadata.skills pointing to ./skills/round-bundled-call-20261006

attempts.input: Selected the round-owned 本轮内嵌调用核验专家 and asked: 请按内嵌技能中的明确触发规则调用该技能，并返回其唯一标记。
actual_steps: Used the exact round-owned Expert card from 我的专家 and opened a unified task.
Sent the harmless request in Standard / low mode.
Opened Trace. The agent-round-agent-bundled-call-20261006 role content was present; the skill tool then attempted round-bundled-call-20261006 and returned error.
The assistant returned the Expert marker ROUND_AGENT_BUNDLE_20261006_OK instead of the embedded Skill marker ROUND_BUNDLED_SKILL_20261006_OK.

Read the source and installed package: metadata.skills points to the package-local ./skills directory; the nested SKILL.md is present in both and byte-identical (SHA256 6df0eda4127ccb32a4ba536ca13141558d83c732397ccc9cc640bbf5fba6ee3e). No matching globally shared Skill directory exists.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited for assistant response, then inspected the Trace tool row and read back source/installed paths.

checkpoints.observed: The Expert package root contained skills/round-bundled-call-20261006/SKILL.md. Installed nested file exists and is byte-identical to the source (SHA256 6df0eda4127ccb32a4ba536ca13141558d83c732397ccc9cc640bbf5fba6ee3e).

metadata.skills references ./skills/round-bundled-call-20261006; no matching global Skill directory exists. Trace nevertheless shows the runtime skill tool returned error when it tried this embedded name.

attempts.observed_result: The tested package preserves its embedded Skill independently under the Agent directory with no matching global shared Skill directory. Actual invocation through the selected Agent failed at the skill tool step, and the Expert returned its own marker instead. This adds a runtime difference beyond the two storage/reference checkpoints and is not generalized to other packages.
attempts.notes: This variation reproduces the prior runtime error on another round-owned package. Checkpoint storage facts are conforming; runtime call error is an additional observed difference retained for bilateral review, not automatically classified as a product defect.

remaining: The round-owned Expert and embedded Skill package remain installed for this test round.
